name: common
notes: Tier D: a finding's message is printed. Every rule was MEASURED on this repo first. EVERY RULE HERE RUNS ON A STDLIB-ONLY MACHINE: an astgrep-tier rule in the core pack would make a default install permanently PARTIAL, which teaches people to ignore the skip line. Written from scratch.

entries.message: A bare `except:` catches KeyboardInterrupt and SystemExit too, so it swallows Ctrl-C and shutdown. Name the exception.
A value compared with itself is always true or always NaN-false; one side is almost certainly the wrong name.
This call executes or deserialises whatever it is given. Use a safe equivalent, or state why the input cannot be hostile.
`assert` is removed entirely under python -O, so an assert used as a runtime check silently stops checking. Raise instead.
A shell script with no `set -u` treats a misspelt variable as empty, so a typo becomes silent wrong behaviour rather than an error.
